summary: Transform your leadership skills with our Customer-Centric Approach Training Course. Learn to prioritize customer needs and drive business success today!
lede: Customer-centric leadership helps CX, service, operations, and product professionals align decisions with customer needs. It is for people responsible for designing, delivering, or managing customer experiences who need to turn feedback and operational data into practical improvements. The course covers customer journey mapping, service blueprinting, Voice of the Customer feedback loops, and measures such as satisfaction, customer effort, and customer lifetime value.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the design, delivery, and management of the customer experience across diverse industries.
audience: Client Relations Manager in professional services
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in a customer-facing, operational, or management role. Familiarity with basic business metrics (revenue, retention) is required. No prior experience with specific CX software is necessary, though a basic understanding of CRM concepts is beneficial.
